title: A small error grows to O(1)
caption: With λ = 0.5 per day the difference 0.001e^(0.5t) grows by a factor e every 2 days and reaches 1 at t = 2 ln 1000 ≈ 13.8 days: an error of one part in a thousand ruins a forecast in two weeks.
alt: An exponential curve of the difference between two weather states, starting at 0.001 and climbing through 1 at 13.8 days.
description: The separation starts at 0.001 and grows as 0.001e^(0.5t).
It is still tiny for the first week, then climbs sharply.
It reaches 1 when e^(0.5t) = 1000, at t = 2 ln 1000 ≈ 13.8 days.
